snippet.title: Doom 2: Junkfood 4 Wad Trailer
snippet.description:
Downloab: https://www.doomworld.com/forum/topic/148999

Junk Food 4 is a MBF21-compatible Speedmapping Community Project held in the Pacifist Paradise Discord Server. The basic premise was to make halloween-themed "Junk Food" slaughter (BFG spammy, high monster count maps). It's just good BFG fun.

Music Credit: "Bustin" by Neil Cicierega - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0tdyU_gW6WE
